conviction_note: Nothing decisive and unpriced turned up. The H1 loss should come in a little deeper than IFIS's -1.0bn ordinary consensus, because of a tough public-solutions comparison that anyone can read in last year's H1 tanshin. A full-year cut is unlikely given Zenrin's revision record, and the street already sits below plan. A buyback is a live but unscheduled tail. So p_up is 47 on a 3.5-point scale (-0.21), close to the findings' sum of -0.3. The small lean comes from five straight prints sold, two of them H1 prints, and a crowded margin long.
bar: IFIS consensus via kabuyoho (2026-10-28): H1 ordinary profit -1,000m JPY; FY ordinary 3,800m, OP 3,500m, sales 64,900m, against the company plan of 3,900 / 3,600 / 66,000 (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=9474 and https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9474). The company publishes no H1 guide. print_vs_bar is my estimate of H1 ordinary (about -1.1bn) against the -1.0bn consensus, expressed on the size of that loss.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register (baseline, as of 2026-10-28): 0.69%, one seller, down from 0.79%, so shorts are small and covering. 信用倍率 5.89 (scraped): leveraged retail is crowded long, which is the setup in which a visible miss still finds sellers. Run-up -4.2% over 20 days and -3.77% over 5, with the price (867) under the April post-print low of 879 and below book (BPS 915.92). No options, so no skew. Baseline priced_lean_pct is +0.44.

findings.finding: Last year's Q2 is a hard comparison. Public-solutions sales were 2,558m in Q2 FY26 (H1 4,417 less Q1 1,859), and the FY26 H1 tanshin says that included pull-forward housing-map deliveries. Public fell 16.8% and mobility 7.6% in Q1 FY27, and Q1 opex rose 240m (which the company says is in its plan). On that run-rate the Q2 operating result comes in near or below zero against +388m a year ago, and H1 ordinary lands around -1.1 to -1.3bn against IFIS's -1.0bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 prints were sold even when good: the 2025-10-29 13:00 release (H1 back in the black) went -2.77% from the open to the next close, and 2024-10-29 went -3.21%. Q1 FY27 (-1,011m OP) went -4.18%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The comparison is in public filings, and IFIS already models Q2 ordinary at about -130m against +446m a year ago. What is left is only my estimate that the Q2 shortfall runs a little deeper than that. If it were fully priced, consensus would already sit near -1.2bn.
findings.independence: Q1 FY27 tanshin segment table (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260729/140120260728500577.pdf) and Q1 presentation (https://www.zenrin.co.jp/company/ir/library/pdf/material/27s1-material.pdf). Both are company documents in the same chain of inference, so they are not independent evidence.

findings.finding: The full-year plan (66.0bn sales, 3.6bn OP) needs a strong H2 after Q1 sales fell 3.3% against a +2.7% plan. Even so, Zenrin did not revise at H1 in FY24, FY25 or FY26. Its one H1 revision in recent years was upward (FY22, 21/10/28), and FY26 was missed at year-end without a revision. IFIS already sits below plan (OP 3.5bn, sales 64.9bn), so holding the plan is the likely outcome and is not a disappointment. A cut is the downside tail.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The FY27 guide on 2026-04-27, below hopes and alongside an FY26 miss, went -8.34% from the open to the next close (kabutan: 後場急落し年初来安値更新). The FY26 guide on 2025-04-25 went +5.23%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Consensus is already about 3% below plan, which covers a modest trim. What the price cannot hold is whether the company cuts at all this time. That is roughly a 15% chance going by its own record, and it would be sized at -3 to -5 if it lands below the street.
findings.independence: IFIS consensus below plan (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9474), a separate source pointing the same way on the bar.

findings.finding: Under ZGP2030, Zenrin targets a 100% cumulative total return over FY26-FY30 with 'flexible' buybacks. At the May 2026 briefing it said FY27 numbers exclude buybacks but it is 'considering execution at a timely and appropriate moment'. No buyback has run since 2018 (treasury shares flat at 3.91m), the stock trades at about 0.95x book near its lows, and FY26-27 dividends alone come to about 82-90% payout. A buyback could arrive with this H1 batch, but the first stage's 4.4bn return allocation equals dividends only.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No buyback announced at a print in the last three years (kabutan disclosure list), so no reaction history on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: The policy is public, but its timing is not. A stock that had priced an imminent buyback would not be sitting under its April low at 0.95x book with a 5.9x margin long. I put the chance it lands today at about 10-15%.
findings.independence: The same policy text is in the FY26 tanshin (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260427/140120260423509298.pdf, 利益配分に関する基本方針). Same company, so not independent.

findings.finding: Japanese new-car sales rose 5.1% in April-September 2026, with registered cars up 9.6% and Toyota up 14.0%. That is a mild tailwind for factory car-navigation data volumes in mobility solutions (about a quarter of sales), although mobility fell 7.6% in Q1 regardless, on a structural decline in in-car navigation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None specific. Mobility fell 13% in FY26 H1 while the stock reacted to the group total.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a public macro series, and transmission to Zenrin is weak. The Q1 decline happened against rising car sales, which is why it is sized near zero.
findings.independence: Same series reported by newswitch (https://newswitch.jp/p/50470). Snippet only.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely by the company's record (no H1 revision FY24-26), street already about 3% below plan, so a hold is neutral and a cut is the tail. Returns: interim dividend fixed at 21; a buyback is possible under the ZGP2030 100% total-return aim but unscheduled. New-year guide: n/a (H1). Quarter: H1 loss widening against FY26 H1's +83m OP. The relevant comparison is the company's own H1 history (FY24 -275, FY25 +83 OP) with profits concentrated in Q4. IFIS H1 ordinary consensus is -1.0bn.
baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly negative, against a mildly positive priced lean (+0.44 from covering shorts and the run-down) but in line with a crowded margin long and a stock that has fallen on five straight prints. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held forecast plus a first buyback since 2018. I looked for both and found a stated intent with no schedule, so the net is close to zero.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the reported-quarter negative rests on a comparison and progress rate anyone can compute from the last two tanshin. Finding cut from -0.5 to -0.3, and p_up moved from 45 to 47 (expected -0.35 to -0.21).
Rule 2: wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension. I had already looked for a held forecast and a buyback, so this moved nothing further.
The guidance, capital-return and proxy findings stand unchanged.
